label: Each bearer making the selected fact is individually contingent
term: contingency of each maker of a selected fact
definition: EveryMakerContingentAt A M w fact requires ContingentAt A.ontic w b for every b with M w b fact: that SAME bearer exists at w and is absent at some accessible world. Making is the primitive bearer-to-fact relation from the existing truthmaker framework; it is not fact explanation or production. This universal predicate does not assert that there is any maker. Individual contingency and fact-level Contingent remain distinct.
note: The proof uses WorldImmanent for actual existence and MakerNecessitation to transport an accessible falsifier of the fact to an absence of its maker. It does not prove that a necessary fact has a necessary maker, that modes are relevant, or that possibilities produce anything.
